title: Stratified Morse Theory for Cell Complexes
summary: We develop a version of discrete Morse theory for finite regular CW complexes equipped with an auxiliary stratification. The key construction is the halo of a cell, which contains all those faces in the boundary that enter closed sublevelsets precisely when the threshold reaches that cell's value. The complement of this halo in the boundary, called the shadow, is always a subcomplex. A stratified discrete Morse function requires Forman's conditions on each stratum together with the requirement that closures of paired cells admit filtered collapses onto their shadows.
